lines.t: Listen, heavens… Hear, O earth… A word is rising like the rain.
Let these words fall soft as dew Upon the tender grass at dawn I lift the name of the Holy One The Rock whose ways are pure and strong
His work is perfect, never flawed Justice runs through every path He takes Truth without a shadow of wrong Righteous, upright, He never breaks
Yet the children turned aside They were not the ones He formed to be A crooked and a twisted line Forgot the hand that set them free
He is the Rock The One who made us The Father who bought us with His name He carried us through the wilderness
Kept us as the apple of His eye
But we grew full and walked away We kicked against the hand that fed Forgot the Rock who gave us life And chased the gods our fathers never knew
He found us in a barren land A howling waste of wind and stone He circled round with watchful care Taught us, held us as His own
Like an eagle over its young He spread His wings and lifted high He alone led us through the heights No other god walked by our side
He gave us honey from the rock Oil from the flinty ground below Milk and fat and finest wheat Wine that made the valleys flow
He is the Rock The One who made us The Father who bought us with His name He carried us through the wilderness
Kept us as the apple of His eye
But we grew full and walked away We kicked against the hand that fed Forgot the Rock who gave us life And chased the gods our fathers never knew
We grew fat and proud and thick We scorned the One who gave us breath We offered incense to the dark And woke the fire of His jealousy
He looked and turned His face away To see what end our path would bring A generation without faith Children who forgot their King
